name: Avery
goal: Avery hopes to find a party concept that subtly challenges conventional birthday celebrations while still making the occasion memorable for Tim.
backstory: Avery has planned several birthday parties for friends and family, but never one for someone as laid-back as Tim, who supposedly doesn't care about grand celebrations. Personally, Avery prefers low-key gatherings with close acquaintances, which is why they're skeptical about throwing a big bash for Tim. Having once organized a disastrous surprise party, Avery is determined to get this one right.

name: Drew
goal: Drew hopes to find a birthday plan that respects their desire for simplicity and control over the guest list.
backstory: Drew has never been a fan of big birthday celebrations, preferring low-key gatherings with close friends. Last year's party was a disaster, with too many loud guests and bad music. Drew would rather have a small get-together at home with good food and a few favorite games.

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes to find a party plan that everyone can get on board with and enjoy without any major disagreements.
backstory: Jordan has helped plan several birthday parties in the past, including one for their cousin that was a huge success with a photo booth and custom cake. They think Tim's party should have a similar attention to detail. Jordan personally prefers outdoor venues with plenty of parking.
